name: whatsapp-ai-automation
description: WhatsApp AI customer-service and sales automation for independent pharmacies. Multi-tenant SaaS.
//engines: 22.12 is a hard floor, not a preference. Baileys 7 is ESM ('type': 'module'); this server is CommonJS. require()-ing an ESM module only works from Node 22.12 onward. On Node 18 or 20 the app throws ERR_REQUIRE_ESM on startup — measured 2026-08-09. Lowering this will produce a crash at boot on the host, not a warning here.

scripts.//test: Lint FIRST. A ReferenceError in a branch no test happens to walk is invisible to the suite but fatal in production — which is exactly how `shelfHasMore` survived being deleted. eslint finds it in milliseconds without touching the database.
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client run build
